Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display 10 "#" on the LCD screen for 2 seconds

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable name Charging Status
2. Assign "#####" to the variable Charging Status
3. Display the variable Charging Status on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable name Charging Status
2. Assign "#####" to the variable Charging Status
3. Display the variable Charging Status on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds
4. Add "###" to the variable Charging Status
5. Display the variable Charging Status on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable name Charging Status
2. Assign "" (Empty Text) to the variable Charging Status
3. Display the variable Charging Status on the LCD Screen
4. When the Button is pressed, add "#" to the variable Charging Status per second

Example 1:
If you pressed the button twice, the LCD will displays "##"
if you pressed the button again, the LCD will displays "###"

Modify your program from the last step of Attack Power Challenge

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable named Attack Power
2. Display "Press and hold to charge attack"" on the LCD screen
3. When Button is pressed and held
- Attack Power will always start from 0
- Attack Power will increase by 10 per second
- When the Attack Power is 100 or below, display "Charging" on top row of the LCD Screen
- When the Attack Power is more than 100, display "Overcharging" on the top row of the LCD Screen and play a sound for 1 second
- Display one "#" per every 10 Attack Power increased on the bottom row of the LCD Screen
4. When Button is released
- If your Attack Power is overcharged, Perform step 2 again,
- If you Attack Power is not overcharged, Perform the next step.
5. Display the Attack Power on the LCD screen for 2 second with the following format:

Attack Power : #

Example 1:
If you increase the Attack Power to 100, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 100

Example 2:
If you increase the Attack Power to 20, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 20

6. Repeat step 2

- Display "You Lose" on the top row of the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

- Display "You Win" on the top row of the LCD Screen for 2 seconds
10 When Defence is equal to Attack Power
- Display "Draw" on the top row of the LCD Screen fro 2 seconds
11. Repeat step 2
